units.source_text: 当然，对局条件同在棋盘上对弈是两码事。

en.t: Of course, the conditions of the match and the play on the board were two different matters.

units.source_text: 也有这样的棋手，他们在下棋的时间和地点这些方面可以礼让，适当照顾对手，但在棋盘上毫不容情。

en.t: There are players like that too: they may yield on matters such as the time and place of a game and show proper consideration for their opponent, but on the board they show no mercy at all.

units.source_text: 从这个意义上说，也许名人碰到了一个坏对手。

en.t: In that sense, perhaps the Master had run into a bad opponent.
